utility.notes: Rancho Cordova is confirmed as an SMUD-served city, corroborated by multiple sources this session including SMUD's own SB379-adjacent municipal code chapter references and general knowledge that Rancho Cordova is within SMUD's core Sacramento County service territory alongside the City of Sacramento, Elk Grove, and Citrus Heights.

value.name: Sacramento Municipal Utility District (SMUD)
value.notes: SMUD is a vertically-integrated municipal utility — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA, consistent with the pattern already established for other SMUD-territory records this session.

value.name: My Energy Optimizer Partner+
value.description: SMUD's own battery storage incentive program (separate from the CPUC/IOU-administered SGIP, which does not apply to SMUD customers as a municipal utility outside CPUC jurisdiction). One-time enrollment incentive of up to $10,000 per household ($500/kWh minus a 20% holdback) for new battery energy storage system customers who enroll within 90 days of receiving Permission to Operate (PTO) from SMUD. Ongoing quarterly incentives are currently only available for Tesla batteries ($110 for 1 battery, $220 for 2, $330 for 3+); other eligible brands (Eguana, Enphase, Franklin, SolarEdge, Sonnen) receive only the one-time enrollment incentive at this time.
value.eligibility: SMUD residential customers with a battery storage unit installed at their home who participate in SMUD's Solar and Storage Rate (SSR). Individual rental units are currently ineligible; multifamily homes are eligible with the same tenant restrictions. MED Rate customers are not eligible.

value.name: SolarAPP+ approval documents (submitted via the Rancho Cordova Online portal)
Standard plan and checklist of all requirements, published on the City's website, substantially conforming to the California Solar Permitting Guidebook

required_documents.notes: Per the City's own Forms and Downloads page (SolarAPP+ submission), and Rancho Cordova Municipal Code Section 16.07.050(D)-(E) (standard plan/checklist substantially conforming to the CA Solar Permitting Guidebook).

value: Only one inspection shall be required and performed by the building department for eligible small residential rooftop solar energy systems (the local fire district may require a separate inspection)
The inspection shall be done in a timely manner and should include consolidated inspections; requested inspections shall be scheduled within one to three business days
If a small residential rooftop solar energy system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is authorized
inspection_steps.notes: Per Rancho Cordova Municipal Code Section 16.07.060(G)-(I).

value.notes: Rancho Cordova Municipal Code Section 16.07.060(A): 'The building department shall issue a building permit, the issuance of which is nondiscretionary, within three business days upon receipt of a complete application that meets the requirements of the approved checklist and standard plan.'

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited Permit Process for Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy Systems (Rancho Cordova Municipal Code Chapter 16.07), submitted to the City via SolarAPP+ and the Rancho Cordova Online portal
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or two-family dwelling
Solar panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the City
